main.description: Provision a new {handle}@gftd.ai mailbox by registering the email→DID binding with the inbound email-relay Worker. After this call, mail sent to that address is parsed by email-relay and stored as ai.gftd.apps.mailer.inboundEmail records on did:web:ml1nb0nd.gftd.ai. Catch-all routing in Cloudflare Email Routing means mail to *@gftd.ai is *received* even without a binding — this command makes the address discoverable by handle and routes it to the requested recipient DID.

handle.description: Local part of the mailbox, before @gftd.ai. Lowercase, alpha-start (a-z), kebab-case allowed. Example: "uspto-acct" → uspto-acct@gftd.ai.

did.description: Recipient DID for the binding. Defaults to did:web:{handle}.gftd.ai (convention from project CLAUDE.md). Pass an explicit DID to override (e.g. did:web:patent.gftd.ai for shared inboxes).

purpose.description: Free-text label (e.g. "USPTO ODP signup", "EPO OPS verification"). Stored on the binding record for ops auditability.
